accessibility.heading: Accessibility Guidelines
accessibility.ariaDescription: Follow these guidelines to ensure your modals are accessible to all users.
focusItems: Focus should move to the first focusable element in the modal when opened
Tab navigation should be trapped within the modal
Focus should return to the trigger element when modal is closed
ESC key should close the modal
screenReaderItems: Use semantic HTML elements (button, form, etc.)
Provide clear, descriptive labels for all interactive elements
Announce modal state changes with live regions

implementation.heading: Implementation Notes
implementation.portalDescription: Render modals in a portal to avoid z-index issues and ensure proper layering.
implementation.animationDescription: Use CSS animations or libraries like Framer Motion for smooth modal transitions.
animationItems: • Scale or slide for modal content
